history.sg_progress: The Business Transformation and Accountability Division has already enhanced its focus on the use of low-value acquisitions as part of its ongoing efforts to strengthen the delegation of authority monitoring framework. As noted by the Board in paragraph 343 of its report, the Division introduced a key performance indicator in 2023 to enable more targeted monitoring and outreach as a second line of defence. Paragraph 345 of the Board’s report further highlights a reduction in the number of low-value acquisitions and blanket purchase orders in 2024 compared with 2023. The Board also acknowledges that a pilot response mechanism for low-value acquisitions was under way at the time of the audit, aimed at deepening understanding of the use of low-value acquisitions and informing follow-up actions in both the first and second lines of defence. To further strengthen monitoring as the first line of defence, the Division will issue a guide to monitoring low-value acquisitions, which will outline the monitoring process, the recommended frequency and analytical procedures, and appropriate action in response to monitoring results.
